summary: F-Secure Oyj operates as a cybersecurity company in Finland and internationally. The company designs and offers security and privacy products and services that help consumers to protect themselves against online threats. It also provides cybersecurity products and services related to endpoint security, privacy protection, password management and digital identity protection, and router security that protects consumers' entire connected home. The company's products include F-Secure Total, an online protection app; F-Secure Internet Security, an antivirus; F-Secure VPN; F-Secure ID Protection, used to protect passwords and online identity; and F-Secure Scam Protection. The company has a strategic collaboration with Identifai Labs S.R.L. for the development of deepfake detection capabilities. F-Secure Oyj was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
